name: modbee-beebus
description: Function blocks that put a BeeBus node inside an OpenPLC program. One node block starts the node — serial, WiFi or Ethernet on Arduino, serial or UDP on the Runtime — and hands out a handle the other blocks take, so a program can hold two segments at once. Registers for Modbus compatibility, and a native topic layer with typed values, publish and subscribe, data quality and store-and-forward. Nothing here configures timing: every protocol timeout is measured from the network.
